summary: A remembered fact keeps the words the room actually used, even once Nora works out what they refer to.
details: Facts were stored so that an object could be either the original wording or a link to a known thing, never both. Working out what something referred to therefore destroyed the phrasing it was said in.

It also broke the check that stops Nora re-researching something she already knows: that check compares the stored wording, which was blank for anything she had resolved, so those claims were queued for research again on every cycle and jumped the queue each time.
Two places that show facts to Nora fell back to printing the internal reference when the wording was missing, putting a raw identifier in front of her.
Nothing had written a resolved object yet, so no stored fact was affected.
